name: With Love Lie Ancients Nestled Within

pitch_detail.notes: Easy initial bolts followed by sustained jug hauling with spectacular position

descent_text: Single lower from the top chain anchor; at 90 ft still within a 60m rope's range.
approach: From Seattle, drive east on I-90 to Snoqualmie Pass and take Exit 54, crossing to the north side of the freeway before turning onto FR 4832, then following it onto FR 4934 to the small trailhead pullout. On foot, cross the road and hike up a spur road for about 15 minutes to a flat bench, then pick up a cairned trail heading north into the forest to a rocky area, staying on the main climber's trail through a short, steeper forest section to reach the crag — roughly 25-30 minutes total from the car. A Northwest Forest Pass is generally expected for parking at national forest trailheads in this corridor.
overview: 5.10b/c sport route on Keechelus Ridge's East Face, featuring sustained jug climbing and described as possibly the best 5.10 at the crag with a spectacular climbing position.
beta: One of the most popular routes at Keechelus and possibly the best 5.10 here. Features easy initial bolts followed by sustained jug hauling with a spectacular position.
